description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Review' controller class in the Admin catalog namespace of an OpenCart project. It manages review-related actions such as listing reviews, filtering, and editing reviews.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for managing product reviews in the admin catalog section, extending the base Controller engine.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main review overview page, including setting up filters, breadcrumbs, and rendering the review list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list reviews, invokes getList to fetch data, and outputs the review list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the list of reviews based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters, then renders the review list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the review form for adding or editing reviews, loads necessary data and review details if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles submission of review data for creation or update, performs validation and returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected reviews after permission check, responds with JSON status.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes review ratings with related product data, handles pagination of results, and returns JSON with progress or success message.

search-terms: review filtering by product, author, status
